summary.text: Greg Hafen (listed by Ballotpedia as Gregory Hafen) is a Republican member of the Nevada State Assembly who has represented District 36 since 2018, is the chamber's Minority Leader, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Greg Hafen was born in Las Vegas, Nevada, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas in 2005; he has worked as general manager of Pahrump Utility Company.
He took office in 2018 after the county commissions of Clark, Lincoln and Nye counties appointed him to replace Dennis Hof, who died weeks before voters elected him to the seat.
For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Health and Human Services, Revenue, and Ways and Means committees.
His Democratic opponent in the 2026 general election is Jon Penn Junejo.
